reader_summary.headline: John-Austin Saviano is the founder of High Country Advisors.
reader_summary.overview: John-Austin Saviano is the founder of High Country Advisors. Before starting High Country in 2017, John-Austin served as an allocator for nearly two decades at the Moore Foundation, Cambridge Associates. Our conversation covers John-Austin's career path from direct investing to allocation and insights gleaned across his roles.
